title: Elevated Histamine Model for In Vitro Study of Histamine Effect on Placenta
author: Obed Brew
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jigckbw

steps.title: Obtain ethics approval
steps.instruction: Secure institutional ethics permission and obtain written patient consent before any placental collection.

steps.title: Record clinical data
steps.instruction: Document clinical characteristics of each pregnancy and compile into Table 1 as per the journal template.

steps.title: Collect and inspect placenta
steps.instruction: Collect placenta delivered by caesarean section at 38–39 weeks gestation from uncomplicated pregnancies; immediately inspect for infarcts, tears, necrosis, absent cotyledons, discolorations, or abnormal cord insertion and record findings.

steps.title: Sample placental tissue
steps.instruction: Using sterile sharp scissors, cut ~2 cm³ of tissue from at least three healthy‑looking sites located ≈5 cm from the umbilical cord; excise each piece so it contains an intact chorionic plate, intervillous space, basal plate, and decidua.

steps.title: Wash tissue samples
steps.instruction: Rinse each sample in phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS, pH 7.4) containing 10 % penicillin‑streptomycin‑L‑glutamine (Sigma) to remove blood and clots.

steps.title: Transport samples to lab
steps.instruction: Place washed samples in sterile 150 mL pots filled with warm PBS plus 10 % penicillin‑streptomycin‑L‑glutamine and transport immediately to the laboratory.

steps.title: Dissect micro‑explants
steps.instruction: Aseptically dissect villous micro‑explants weighing <50 mg wet weight from each sample with a sterile scalpel; process explants within 30 min of delivery.

steps.title: Set up explant culture
steps.instruction: Place each fragmented explant onto a 15 mm diameter Netwell insert (74 µm polyester mesh, Corning, UK) positioned in a 12‑well culture plate.

steps.title: Add basic culture medium
steps.instruction: Add RPMI 1640 (Invitrogen, UK) supplemented with 2 mM L‑glutamine, 10 % fetal bovine serum, 100 IU ml⁻¹ penicillin, and 100 µg ml⁻¹ streptomycin.

steps.title: Incubate explants
steps.instruction: Incubate at the liquid‑gas interface in a humidified incubator set to 8 % O₂, 5 % CO₂, 37 °C for 5 days; avoid submerging explants at the bottom of the well.

steps.title: Replace media days 2 & 4
steps.instruction: On days 2 and 4, transfer replacement medium to a sterile container, pre‑equilibrate at 8 % O₂ for 2 h, then change the culture medium in <5 min.

steps.title: Elevated histamine treatment
steps.instruction: On day 5, perform a media change: for dHDA samples add medium containing 100 nM histamine plus 10⁻⁴ M aminoguanidine; for nHDA samples add basic medium without histamine or aminoguanidine; continue culture for an additional 24 h.

steps.title: Collect and store explants
steps.instruction: At the end of the 6‑day culture, harvest explants and immediately place them in RNAlater (Ambion) before storing at –80 °C.

steps.title: Store 0 h controls
steps.instruction: Place pre‑culture (0 h) control samples obtained from fresh placentae in RNAlater and freeze at –80 °C within 30 min of delivery.
